description: The plot illustrates how the metric labeled “minFDE\(_{20}\) (←)” varies with the “Number of Examples” for two methods, shown as separate lines. The x-axis is labeled “Number of Examples,” uses a linear scale, and spans integer values from 0 to 8 with ticks at each integer. The y-axis is labeled “minFDE\(_{20}\) (←),” uses a linear scale, and shows values roughly from about 0.205 up to about 0.245 with evenly spaced tick marks (approximately 0.01 apart). The ST-ES series is drawn as a blue solid line with circular markers; it starts near 0.244 at 0 examples, drops sharply to about 0.212 at 1 example, then stays in a narrow band around ~0.206–0.212 through 8 examples, reaching about 0.212 again at 8 (with a low point around ~0.206 at 4). The Random series is drawn as an orange solid line with circular markers; it begins around 0.232 at 0 examples, decreases to about 0.223 at 1, then fluctuates slightly around ~0.222–0.226 across the remaining x-values, ending near 0.228 at 8 (with a local low around ~0.222 at 6).
